name: 注目の入口と商品分類を分けるナビゲーションパネル
prompt:
Make one scoped geometry correction to existing Lighthouse catalog candidate LH07-0116. Reference 1 is the original 1340 × 482 crop and is the positional authority. Reference 2 preserves the exact Japanese copy and order. Reference 3 is attempt 001; keep its visual style, typography, text size, line spacing, weights, colors, and all content unchanged.

Correct only these observed defects:
- Remove the extra top inset: place the first row's glyph tops at the same near-edge position as the original crop (about 0–1% of image height), without clipping.
- Remove the extra left inset: align the first featured link with the left edge of the crop (x=0%).
- Match the original horizontal column anchors across the full width: first link column x=0%; Accessories heading and first link column x=34.5%; its second link column x=57.5%; Bags heading and link column x=80.4%.
- Keep the original 1340:482 aspect ratio and existing vertical row rhythm. Do not resize text, reflow or translate labels, change any Japanese glyph, alter group headings, or move content other than these anchors and the top/left inset.

Preserve the complete Japanese text exactly as it appears in attempt 001. Keep one featured-link column, the two-column Accessories group, and one Bags column. Maintain plain dark text on pure white. No icons, cards, borders, buttons, logos, photography, tinted surfaces, gradients, accents, extra labels, or outside margins. Output only the corrected menu.
reviewNotes: Compared at 1340x482 target bounds and at original 2091x752 size against the source crop. All 32 Japanese link labels and two headings are legible and ordered; the white/dark-neutral four-column structure is preserved and no protected media was in scope. One correction removed the top/left padding. Small remaining horizontal anchor drift (about 0.5-0.8% width by visual estimate; see comparison-attempt-002.png) remains, so status is needs-correction after the one-correction budget.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
